e: Name of the program, short for new roff; an earlier similar program was called roff, a shortening of runoff.
q: The user either selects a new filename, edits the default file, nroffs it to the screen, or to a printer, or logs out.
1985, Eric Foxley, UNIX for super-users, page 158:
You could contrive macro sets that nroffed a document onto a printer […]
